entries.title: Sign in to GitLab in your browser
entries.body: Settings → Projects guides you through registering Firstmate on gitlab.com or your own GitLab server, then shows a code to approve in your browser. You can still use a key instead. Browser sign-in needs GitLab 17.9 or newer.

picture.alt: GitLab browser sign-in setup with registration instructions, an Application ID field and a key alternative
